plain: A common man who owns his own land

webster.text: A common man, or one of the plebeians, of the first or most respectable class; a freeholder; a man free born.

example.quote: A substantial yeoman, of sense and discernment, will hardly ever be chosen.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 21, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
